name: Ignore and Inclusion Policies
description: Implement ignore and inclusion policies that control which files are indexed, analyzed, and tracked. Respect .gitignore patterns by default. Introduce .tribunusignore for Tribunus-specific exclusions. Define inclusion policies that override ignores for specific paths or patterns needed for analysis (e.g., include .env.example for schema analysis). Support layered policy resolution.
purpose: Not all files in a repository are relevant to workspace operations. Generated output directories (node_modules, .git, build/) should be excluded by default, while certain ignored files may still be useful for analysis. A clear policy model prevents wasteful indexing and respects user boundaries.
acceptanceCriteria: .gitignore patterns are automatically respected for indexing and analysis
.tribunusignore file extends or overrides .gitignore for Tribunus-specific purposes
Inclusion policies can selectively include files that would otherwise be ignored
Policy changes trigger reindexing of affected files
Policies are per-repository with optional global workspace defaults
Policy patterns support the same syntax as .gitignore (glob, negation, etc.)
Policies are queryable and editable via CLI and API
